page.overview:
Who is Subaru?

Subaru is a tall man with messy black hair and a short beard.

Subaru is shown to be serious about his job, prioritizing it over other things and analyzing the situation accordingly when being questioned.

When Makima finds out that Denji's existence is revealed in the media, and that assassins from other countries will come to kill him, Makima orders her subordinates to bring in several Public Safety Devil Hunters, including Subaru.

When Subaru, Kurose, and Tendo are driving to Tokyo, the trio of brothers set down a spike strip and make them crash. The brothers then shoot them all dead.
